summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any tests or repository code, and nothing was committed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs; __all__ exports Tab and Tabs); UnderlineBar now yields one Text with clickable_ranges click spans added last, and the zero-width early path adds no click metadata; Opacity merges the blended color into the existing style so click metadata is kept. The layout resolver was left unchanged because its Edge protocol already declares size, min_size, and fraction. Tests were added in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py (four new tests) and a new tests/test_tabs.py; both are unexecuted. Also added docs/reference/tabs.md and sandbox/tabs_demo.py with tabs_demo.css. Choices to review: bar position indexes the full tab list and is mapped to the displayed tab by name, so duplicate names stay aligned; inactive labels are wrapped in Opacity; Escape with no tabs does nothing; the letter-search flag is checked inside activate_tab_by_first_char. Known unfixed edge case: an empty label has width 0, which the resolver treats as flexible, so it takes one cell.
